notes: Hard (total 18). The gloo competency (floor hard) anchors the bucket: the agent must run a rank-aware multi-process distributed aggregation spawned across N processes under the gloo CPU collective backend with correct device/dtype movement, and prove it with per-rank worker markers plus an exact all-reduced sum; a wrong gloo backend, missing spawn guard, or dtype/device mismatch fails the markers/sum check. tool_breadth 3 comes from five heterogeneous subsystems (torch/gloo, mpicc+mpirun, moto+aws CLI, gcc protocol server, postfix+mlmmj). hidden_case_generalization 3: every deliverable is re-run on three strictly different hidden scenarios (varying MPI data, netflow/telemetry flows, gloo world sizes, S3 bucket names, mailing-list names). quantitative_correctness 3 via byte-exact netflow v5 fields, exact gloo sum, and MPI parallel==serial equality. dependent_stages 2: the Meridian-7 reverse-engineered protocol feeds the netflow exporter, and run-all ties MPI+markers+gloo+S3+mail into one coherent cluster. resource_pressure 1 (daemons/services transiently up). debugging_ambiguity 2 (protocol auth framing, mlmmj routing, gloo spawn). Interaction-statefulness 1 (services must stay up for verification).
